title: ICAC Topic
description: A concept in the ICAC domain of discourse, tracked and anchored to the CAC Ontology. Enum values for domain, category, and facets are checked separately against content/taxonomy.yml by tools/validate.py, because they are data rather than schema.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the filename stem. Never reuse or repurpose an id.

label.description: The name the domain actually uses for this concept.

aliases.description: Other names in circulation. Fed into search so people find the concept under whatever name they know.

category.description: Taxonomy category id within the domain.

definition.description: What this concept means in this domain, in plain language. Definitional, not argumentative.

why_it_matters.description: Why the concept is worth tracking. This is where an argument belongs.

current_understanding.description: The state of play, in prose. What is known, what is contested, what changed recently.

open_questions.description: Questions the field has not settled. Distinct from threads, which are work someone can pick up.

maturity.description: Taxonomy facet: emerging | active | established | historical.

cac_alignment.description: How this concept sits against the CAC Ontology. The point of the tracker.

classes.description: CAC classes that model this concept. Validated against content/cac-index.json — an unknown IRI fails the build.

notes.description: What is covered, what is missing, and what an extension would need to add.

proposal_url.description: Upstream issue or PR, when status is proposed.

threads.description: Open work items attached to this topic. This is what a contributor picks up.

done_when.description: Concrete completion criteria. A thread without these is a wish, not a task.

claimed_by.description: GitHub handle of whoever picked it up.

outcome.description: Required in spirit once status is done or archived.

references.description: Public sources only. At least one is required — a topic nobody has written about publicly is not yet trackable here.

related_topics.description: Other topic ids. Validated for existence at build time; edges are rendered both ways.

url.description: Must be https and publicly reachable without credentials. See SCOPE.md.
